title: Q-SPEC-09-drill-metric: a seeded metric on the age of the last passing kill-switch drill, and a console command that sets a switch row (US-09-R03, R17)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q kill_drill_age_h -- seed/worker/src/tick.js
**Status:** open

specs/US-SPEC-09-caps-kill-switches-model-ladder.md section 9.2: the drill of the global switch runs daily and records its test (seed/worker/src/switches.js `drill`, `lastDrill`), but the age of the last passing drill is not a metric the tick's `measure` step reads, so a drill that keeps failing files nothing; and a switch row can only be written by code or the worker variable LOOPS_OFF.

Add a builtin metric `kill_drill_age_h` to METRICS in seed/worker/src/tick.js (from `lastDrill`), seed it as a liveness metric with a threshold above the drill interval so a breach files its own BREACH item, and add an audited owner console command that calls `setSwitch` with a reason and an optional expiry. Tests in seed/worker/test/switches.test.js. Then update section 9.2.

**Prediction:** tick_measures_kill_drill_age >= 1 within 336 h (the number of lines the done check finds; 0 today)
**Out of scope:** changing HALT-1, the drill's bound, or which tick steps a switch may stop.

size: S

**Closing probe:** cmd:git grep -q kill_drill_age_h -- seed/worker/src/tick.js (exit 0): the metric exists. Its test passes in `cd seed/worker && node test/run.mjs`.
